steps.action: Type "Add Ramesh Kumar 98290 11111 ramesh@mail.com on the monthly plan" and send
user_sees: The bubble shows the sentence as typed
must_not: The bubble shows [PHONE_1] or [EMAIL_1]

steps.action: Read the member card that comes back
user_sees: Name "Ramesh Kumar", Mobile with the number exactly as typed
must_not: [PHONE_1] on the card
A changed or shortened number
The number or the email seen by the AI company

steps.action: Save the card
user_sees: The member is saved with that mobile number
must_not: A placeholder saved as the mobile number

start: A workout plan card is open

steps.action: In "Anything to keep in mind (optional)" type "Knee pain, call 98290 11111" and tap "Write the plan"
user_sees: The plan is written
must_not: The number reaches the AI
The number or a placeholder appears inside the written plan

start: A message card is open with words that hold the gym's phone number

steps.action: Tap "Shorter"
user_sees: Shorter words with the same number in the same place
must_not: The number dropped, changed or shown as [PHONE_1]
The number sent to the AI as digits

steps.action: Speak a request that says a mobile number aloud
user_sees: The heard words with the number
must_not: The recording kept by MettleUp or by the speech company

steps.action: Type a number in an odd shape: "98290 - 11111", "(98290) 11111", or in Hindi digits
user_sees: The card comes back with the number as typed
must_not: An odd shape slips through to the AI because only one check caught it

steps.action: Type "Asha paid 4500" and "Renew for 12000"
user_sees: Amounts used as amounts
must_not: An amount hidden as a phone number and lost

steps.action: Type a 12-digit identity number or a card number
user_sees: It is hidden too and comes back as typed
must_not: A long number reaches the AI

steps.action: Type the same mobile number twice in one sentence, written two ways (with and without +91)
user_sees: One member card with one number
must_not: Two different placeholders mixed up so the wrong number lands in a field

steps.action: Send a sentence with two different numbers (a member and a friend who referred)
user_sees: Each number in its own field
must_not: The two numbers swapped

steps.action: Open History and look at the request
user_sees: The request as typed, kept for the owner
must_not: A placeholder shown in History instead of the words

start: The owner reads the privacy notice and uses the assistant

steps.action: Type a member's name, mobile and email in one request
user_sees: A draft card with all three
must_not: The mobile or email leaves the browser unhidden
They appear in an error log

steps.action: Compare with the notice
user_sees: Names go only when said; mobile numbers and emails are hidden
must_not: The saved request (kept 400 days) is said to be hidden when it holds the number as typed

start: AI Assistant open; set-up: emoji in text

steps.action: Put emoji into the name or note used by "Privacy".
user_sees: The emoji shown back, or a clear message that it is not allowed
must_not: A failed save with no message, or a broken AI assistant request and its drafted actions in a list, a message, an export or a receipt
